name: Pain - Tendo [Six Paths Rinnegan]

transformation.name: Outer Path - Six Paths of Pain

balanceNote: Cooldowns updated by request: base 2, Extreme 3, Final 2 (up to two casts in an eligible round), Chase 2, Laser 2 rounds. Mystery recovery persists across HP form changes and revival. Other explicit numbers and forms follow the supplied screenshot. Damage coefficients and the unspecified 'certain amount' of Chase penetration (30%) are local configurable values, not stated in the reference. Damage-triggered Attack scaling stacks additively per damaged target; TP bonuses are a separate multiplier. Shared camp Chakra is used by this engine. Final critical-hit cost increase lasts through the current round, matching the other +20 cost effect. Splash uses orthogonally adjacent battlefield grids and deals 30% of the primary hit. Base revival is once at 100% HP; final revival requires another defeated allied ninja, once at 40% HP. Final form has only its two stated skills. All damaging moves scale exclusively with Physical ATK, including Laser, Final and Super Push; damage type still selects Defense/Resistance mitigation. Laser targeting is overridden by request to hit all living enemy combat units in every row.
